method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (lpa-core.l4, two regulative rules: the s 332(2) itemised bill MUST and the s 329(1) recovery-proceedings SHANT), date helpers (lpa-dates.l4, no daydate import, no YMD) and a seat layer (lpa-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Legal Profession Act 2007 (Qld) (act-2007-024), in force from 2025-07-01, the current version on 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2007-024.txt. Not deposited: the Legal Profession Regulation (the Act's fallback threshold amounts of $1,500 and $3,000 are used; the s 321(3) maximum interest rate is an input). The s 347 formula is an unconverted image in the deposit, so Division 8 is not encoded.

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lpa-dates.l4 ; l4 run lpa-core.l4 ; l4 run lpa-seat.l4 ; l4 run lpa-cases-client.l4
checks.result: 104 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-11-07); 2 #TRACEs with an expect line, each ending in the expected breach
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the client, Part 3.4 with costs agreements as the focus: s 300 (definitions); ss 302-304 (application); ss 307A, 307B(1), 308(1)-(2), 311(1)(b)-(e) (which disclosure); s 313 (uplift disclosure); s 316(1)-(2), (4)-(5) (failure to disclose); s 317 (reports); s 321 (interest); ss 322(1)-(5), 323, 324, 325, 326, 327, 328(1), (4)-(6), (10) (costs agreements: form, conditional agreements, uplift fees and the 25% cap, contingency fees, void agreements, setting aside); ss 329(1), (3), 332(1)-(2), (4)-(6) (bills; two regulative rules); ss 335(1), (5)-(6), 338, 340, 342(2)-(3), 344 (assessment). Out: Division 8 s 347 (formula image not converted in the deposit), disclosure contents and timing (ss 307B(2), 308(4)-(8), 309-310A, 312, 314-315, 318), ss 299, 301, 305-307, 319-320, the form and service of bills (ss 330-331, 333), third party payers' and law practices' applications and the assessment criteria (ss 334, 335(2)-(4), (7)-(11), 336-337, 339, 341, 343), Division 9, and the rest of the Act.
seat: the client (the person to whom or for whom a law practice provides legal services, for example a personal injury claimant who retains a law practice)
